name: Production Call Sheet
svgFragment:
<g id="PROP-CALLSHEET">
  <!-- Drop Shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="265" rx="90" ry="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.2" />

  <!-- Clipboard Backboard -->
  <rect x="115" y="35" width="170" height="220" rx="12" fill="#d97706" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- Wood Grain Highlights (Interior Details) -->
  <path d="M125 50 L125 240 M275 70 L275 230" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Paper Sheet -->
  <rect x="127" y="65" width="146" height="180" rx="4" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <!-- Paper Highlight (Sheen) -->
  <path d="M127 65 L210 65 L127 180 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35" />

  <!-- Call Sheet Content -->
  <!-- Title: PRANK #47 -->
  <text x="200" y="95" font-family="Impact, Arial Black, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#ef4444" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-1 200 95)">PRANK #47</text>
  <text x="200" y="112" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="8" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="1.5">PRODUCTION CALL SHEET</text>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="137" y1="122" x2="263" y2="122" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Checkbox 1: Shocked Bodybuilder -->
  <rect x="142" y="137" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="3.5" />
  <path d="M145 145 L149 149 L155 141" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <text x="166" y="150" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" font-size="10" fill="#1e293b">Shocked Bodybuilder</text>

  <!-- Checkbox 2: Dramatic Zoom -->
  <rect x="142" y="167" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="3.5" />
  <path d="M145 175 L149 179 L155 171" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <text x="166" y="180" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" font-size="10" fill="#1e293b">Dramatic Zoom</text>

  <!-- Extra Form Lines -->
  <line x1="142" y1="205" x2="258" y2="205" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <line x1="142" y1="218" x2="230" y2="218" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <line x1="142" y1="230" x2="250" y2="230" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Clipboard Metal Clip (Top) -->
  <path d="M160 55 L240 55 L230 32 L170 32 Z" fill="#64748b" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <path d="M160 55 L240 55 L230 32 L170 32 Z" fill="#94a3b8" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <!-- Clip Pressure Bar -->
  <rect x="175" y="45" width="50" height="12" rx="3" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3.5" />
  <!-- Clip Fastener/Spring -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="38" r="5" fill="#475569" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3" />
</g>
